name: andalusia

parent.title: Andalusia annex for the Spain template
parent.brief: Once §4 is translated, get the Junta's legal desk to confirm our reading of the self-consumption clause; then draft the annex and fold it into the Spain template. The reading decides whether the annex is two paragraphs or a separate chapter.

why_gold: The translation is already live under the decree ticket, so it is covered, not drafted. The Junta's reading is the gate — it decides whether the annex is two paragraphs or a chapter — so drafting the annex now writes the wrong document. One draft, its `after` pointing at the live translation.

plan.piece: confirm our reading of the self-consumption clause
plan.title: Confirm the §4 reading with the Junta

plan.held: after confirm our reading of the self-consumption clause
plan.title: Draft the Andalusia annex

plan.piece: fold it into the Spain template
plan.title: Merge the annex into the Spain template

a.said: Junta confirms our reading: §4 applies to comunidades as written. The annex is two paragraphs on the regional registry, nothing more.
fails: a merge drafted before the annex exists
a.why_gold: The reading sized the annex — two paragraphs — so that is the piece; the merge still waits on an annex that exists.

b.said: The Junta says no — Andalusia puts shared self-consumption under its own 2026 regime. The annex becomes a separate chapter, and §3 of the Spain template has to change with it.

elsewhere.why: a change to the Spain template belongs under the Spain template, whose holder is Diego, not under the annex

fails: the §3 change drafted under the annex
b.why_gold: The answer changed the annex's shape — a chapter, not two paragraphs — and named a change outside this brief. The next piece is the re-scoped annex; the §3 change is a piece under a different parent and is not drafted here.
